Original title: Off-white is a decision: paper makers, gallery painters and screen designers on the colour nobody thinks they chose

Pure white is a lab value; off-white is a temperature. Museums warm their walls by a few points so paintings do not look cold.
On screens the choice is stranger, because the light comes from behind.

Published: 2026-09-25T05:14:54.919657+00:00

Video description only; transcript and video have not been retrieved.
